text:
Geelani became APHC chairman in 1998, succeeding Maulvi Umar Farooq, according to the Wikipedia entry on Geelani. That entry gives his tenure as 1998 to 20 July 2000, and the search didn't explain why the handover happened. The earlier 1993–1998 tenure I cited for Umar Farooq is consistent with this.

Sources: [Syed Ali Shah Geelani (Wikipedia)](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Syed_Ali_Shah_Geelani)

CONFIDENCE: 80
